			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_state = 4
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_id > 0
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_hash = scope:zg361_we_ad_expected_offer_source_hash
			OR = { var:zg361_wad_offer_source_response = 1 var:zg361_wad_offer_source_response = 2 }
			has_variable = zg361_we_offer_source_retired_id
			has_variable = zg361_we_offer_source_retired_hash
			var:zg361_we_offer_source_retired_id = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_id
			var:zg361_we_offer_source_retired_hash = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_hash
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 3 } }
}

zg361_we_retire_offer_source_after_m275_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_ad_source_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_ad_source_red_code
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_id
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_case
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_response
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_ad_expected_offer_source_hash
			value = { value = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_id multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_cycle multiply = 10000 } add = { value = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_case multiply = 10 } add = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_response }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_pending
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_retired
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_owner
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_subject
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_case
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_state
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_id
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_hash
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_response
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_pending = 1
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_consumed = 0
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_retired = 0
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_state = 4
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_id > 0
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_hash = scope:zg361_we_ad_expected_offer_source_hash
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_response = 2
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_choice
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_open
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_visible_to_settlement
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_consumed_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_consumed_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_consumed_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_consumed_case
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_consumed_state
			var:zg361_we_m275_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_we_m275_choice = 3
			var:zg361_we_m275_debt_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_m275_debt_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m275_debt_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_we_m275_debt_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_we_m275_debt_state = 4
			var:zg361_we_m275_debt_open = 1
			var:zg361_we_m275_debt_consumed = 0
			var:zg361_we_m275_debt_visible_to_settlement = 1
			var:zg361_we_m275_consumed_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_m275_consumed_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m275_consumed_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_we_m275_consumed_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_we_m275_consumed_state = 4
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
				RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m275_receipt_owner
				RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m275_receipt_subject
				RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m275_receipt_cycle
				RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m275_receipt_case
				RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m275_receipt_state
				RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m275_receipt_choice
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 4
				EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_offer_source_retired_id value = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_offer_source_retired_hash value = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_hash }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_wad_offer_source_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_wad_offer_source_retired value = 1 } # never marks consumed
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_pending
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_retired
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_owner
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_subject
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_case
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_state
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_id
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_hash
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_response
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_pending = 0
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_consumed = 0
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_retired = 1
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_state = 4
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_id > 0
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_hash = scope:zg361_we_ad_expected_offer_source_hash
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_response = 2
			has_variable = zg361_we_offer_source_retired_id
			has_variable = zg361_we_offer_source_retired_hash
			var:zg361_we_offer_source_retired_id = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_id
			var:zg361_we_offer_source_retired_hash = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_hash
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 3 } }
}
